content:
Excel workbook generation failed due to incorrect formula propagation across columns, resulting in static values instead of dynamic growth calculations.
The verifier reported failures in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, columns I through L in the 'Task' sheet contained identical values instead of the expected incremental growth (e.g., I12-L12 all returned 302.5 instead of scaling from 330.7 to 426.9). This indicates a failure to correctly apply weighted growth or risk factors across the horizontal axis of the matrix. Concrete errors include 'I12: expected 330.7, got 302.5' and 'I35: expected -17.22, got -18.51'. Ensure formulas in the workbook correctly reference relative column offsets for time-series or weighted throughput projections.
